text: The system shall accept from Work and Coordination each unit of work that it sends to an agent.
rationale: DEC-140. REQ-WC-011, REQ-WC-012 and REQ-WC-046 send a unit to an agent, and this system is where it arrives.

text: The system shall start a run of the agent to which Work and Coordination sent a unit of work when it accepts that unit.
rationale: DEC-140. Work and Coordination chose the agent (DEC-030), so this system does not choose again.

text: The system shall accept from Interaction each turn of the user in an exchange, with the agent of that exchange.
rationale: DEC-142. Interaction attaches the exchange to its agent (REQ-IA-003, REQ-IA-004), so this system does not choose it.

text: The system shall give Interaction the reply of the agent to each turn of the user, in the exchange in which the user gave that turn.
rationale: DEC-142 and REQ-PL-010.

text: The system shall give Interaction the first part of the reply to a spoken turn within TBD.
rationale: REQ-IA-009 and OPN-003. The time of a spoken turn is mostly the time of the model, and this is the part of the bound that this system holds.

text: The system shall run an agent with what states that agent as Agent Definition gives it when the run starts.
rationale: REQ-PL-016 and DEC-117. A change to an agent takes effect at its next run, so a run is always traceable to one configuration.

text: The system shall give the model of an agent, at the start of each run, the rules that bound every caller.
rationale: REQ-PL-027 and REQ-AD-055. Agent Definition gives the rules, and this system gives them to the model.

text: The system shall give the model of an agent, at the start of each run, each act that the identity of that agent names and that its position admits.
rationale: DEC-144 and DEC-149. Actuation gives only the acts that the position admits (REQ-AC-008, REQ-AC-042), and what each act carries is below this level.

text: The system shall give the model of an agent, at the start of the run of a unit of work, that unit as Work and Coordination gives it.
rationale: REQ-PL-007. The unit and what the agent wrote to it (DEC-147) are how a run continues work that an earlier run started.

text: The system shall give each call to a model to External Access.
rationale: DEC-124 and REQ-EX-020. INT-PL-67.

text: The system shall state, with each call to a model, the agent of the run.
rationale: REQ-EX-024 keeps the calls of two agents after the limit of the month, and External Access checks no authority of its own (DEC-123).

text: The system shall accept from External Access the result of each call to a model, or that the call returned no result.
rationale: REQ-EX-021. INT-PL-68.

text: The system shall give Actuation each call of the agent to an act.
rationale: DEC-111 and REQ-PL-032.

text: The system shall state, with each call to Actuation, the agent of the run as the caller, and shall not accept the caller from the model.
rationale: REQ-PL-029, DEC-140 and REQ-AC-027. The model writes the call, so a caller that it states is one that it can change.

text: The system shall get from Actuation an act that the agent asks for, when the agent asks for it.
rationale: DEC-149 and DEC-069.

text: The system shall give the agent the result of each call to an act as Actuation gives it, or that the call returned no result.
rationale: REQ-AC-011 and REQ-AC-031.

text: The system shall accept from Work and Coordination each note on a unit of work whose run is running.
rationale: DEC-148 and DEC-150.

text: The system shall give the agent each note on the unit of its run before the next call to its model.
rationale: DEC-148. The agent reads it between two turns, and the note is added at the end of the context, so DEC-144 holds.

text: The system shall give Work and Coordination, when the run of a unit of work ends, whether the agent ended the run, the run reached its bound, or the run failed.
rationale: DEC-147. The next run of the unit reads it, and it can be the run of another agent. A unit whose run is running closes only by its agent (DEC-150), so that is a run that the agent ended.

text: The system shall give Work and Coordination, with how the run of a unit of work ended, the cost of that run.
The system shall give the model of an agent no tool that runs on the host other than the acts that Actuation gives.
rationale: DEC-130 and DEC-124. A tool that the provider runs is refused by External Access (REQ-EX-041), and this is the other path.

text: The system shall not send a call to an act again.
rationale: An act can have its effect when its call returns no result (RSK-AC-004). The agent sees that the call returned no result (REQ-RN-017) and decides.

text: The system shall discard the context of a run when the run ends.
rationale: DEC-146 and DEC-120.

text: The system shall not hold a run open to wait for a unit of work that the agent raised.
The system shall let the agent know that its run nears its bound before the system ends the run.
rationale: DEC-145 and DEC-147. The next run of the unit needs the note, and a run that stops with no warning loses what the agent had not written. How the agent is told is below this level.

text: The system shall end the run of a unit of work when its cost reaches the bound that Agent Definition holds for the agent of that run for the run of a unit.
rationale: DEC-145. The bound is held with the agent (REQ-AD-070) and fixed when the run starts (REQ-RN-006).

text: The system shall not carry a call to an act on a turn of the user after the cost of that turn reaches the bound that Agent Definition holds for that agent for a turn.
rationale: DEC-145. The agent still replies (REQ-RN-004), from what it found before the bound. A request that needs more work than one turn becomes a unit of work that runs under its own bound, and the user does not wait on an open turn.

text: The system shall continue a run whose context reaches the limit of the model of its agent.
rationale: DEC-146. How the context is made shorter is below this level.

text: The system shall continue a run when one call to a model returns no result.
rationale: A call to a model changes nothing outside the platform, so it can be made again, which is not true of an act (REQ-RN-023). External Access does not repeat a call (REQ-EX-022), so a repeat is a new call from this system. How many times is below this level.
